lines.english: Summer continues, and the heat grows only more powerful.
So powerful that one could forget all about how blue the sky is, or how high it soars above us.
"Setsuna?"
Sweat pouring out just by standing outside during the day, and discomfort no matter how many times I turn over in bed during the night.
No…
Is that truly the only thing it has deprived me of?
"Setsuna! I'm opening the door."
"Mh…"
"…What's the matter? Why would you cover your body head to toe in this scorching heat? You'll get a heatstroke like this."
"Aah… you're right. Good morning."
"Don't you 'good morning' me! What time do you think it is? What about work?"
"Aah… Sorry, I forgot to tell you. I asked for sick leave yesterday night, so I'm off work today."
"You did?"
"Yeah, it started yesterday night. It's pretty heavy this month…"
"Oh, then you should've told us yesterday too. Now the breakfast's gone all cold."
"I'm sorry… but I don't need any today. You don't have to make lunch for me either."
"Setsuna…"
"It's really bad… I don't have any appetite at all right now."
"Are you okay?"
"I'm okay. I just have to make it through the day…"
"…Are you sure it's just your menstruation?"
"I am… but you really don't have to say it out loud."
"Give me a day and I'll be fine. I'll go to work tomorrow too, so just leave me alone for today."
"If you say so, I guess I'll believe you for today…"
"That's how it is, so good night."
"But if you feel there's anything wrong with your body… No, if you feel even the slightest bit unusual, you'll tell me right away, okay?"
"I get it already."
There's no way I could tell her…
"Now then, good night. Mommy will be heading out today, but…"
"Off you go then. I'll be fine. I can handle this much."
If I ever did, she'd probably tell Dad.
And then Dad would get pointlessly worried about me.
"…Fine, but be a good girl, okay? Don't think about going to 'that place' again with the excuse that you suddenly got better. Not today of all days."
"I said I got it…"
Then he'd never let me visit "that place" again.
"～～～! Aah, aaah, aah…!"
After I've made sure Mom's gone downstairs, I finally crawl out of the blanket covering me.
My pajamas are so drenched in sweat it feels gross. How strange… Doesn't our air conditioner work?
Mom will notice when she does the laundry. I'll have to make sure to wash them myself when she's out.
"Aah… ah."
Last night…
Sweat was disgustingly pouring out of my entire body all night, non-stop.
Even now in the morning, it still hasn't stopped.
…In fact, it didn't even start last night. I've been like this every night the past few days.
"It's so… warm."
I raise my body to get out of bed, only to immediately slump back.
I feel dizzy, my vision is blurry, and worst of all, I have no energy.
I always managed to get out of bed despite that until yesterday. I'd get dressed in the morning like always, and then head out for work.
…Though my performance at work was less than impressive.
"I have to… call work."
What I told Mom about having the day off was of course a makeshift lie. The truth was that I simply couldn't get up.
What's going on? What's happening to me…?
"I'm… fine."
No, this is plain and simple heat fatigue. I'll be back to normal after a good day's rest.
Because tomorrow is Friday. I just have to work one more day and it'll be the weekend… That's why… I'll be fine.
I'll be able to see him again then. I just have to hang in there one more day, and I'll get to see Haruki-kun again. He must be waiting for me.
That's the reason I can hang on…
"The train on Line 1 toward Onjuku will depart shortly. Please stay within the white lines."
And so…
The weekend I was so eagerly waiting for arrived… half a day later than usual.
Normally I'd head straight for his apartment after work on Friday. But right now, I'm heading there at 11 o'clock on Saturday.
Unsurprisingly, my family didn't allow me to visit him on Fridayーnot after having spent the entirety of Thursday bedridden.
So left without a choice, I spent the night resting at home.
I felt a lot better this morning thanks to that. My headache and sweating are all gone, but most importantly of all, I got a decent night's sleep.
So there's nothing to worry about anymore.
I almost forgot… I should do some groceries before I go to his apartment.
A week's worth of food, daily necessities… Oh, didn't he run out of laundry detergent last time?
Then when I've arrived at his place, I'll have to make something we can eat together. Then there's the laundry, cleaning and finally, dinner.
When all that's over with, I'd like to… chat with him, if possible.
About all the things I've done this week, and about how he's been the past week.
Speak, listen, and understand each other…
"The train on Line 1 is departing. The doors are closing. Please be careful."
Yeah, the day will go something like that.
Then we'll be able to spend much more time together.
It'll mark the start of a period so full of joy, that we'll forget all about work and the scorching heat of summer.
Just thinking about it makes my heart leap.
"…! Ah, aah… Haaah…!"
I thought my heart was going to leap, yet…
"Huh…?"
Something's wrong.
My breath feels heavy. My sweating won't stop.
How strange… I felt fine this morning.
I had so much energy that I was easily able to shake Mom off when she tried to stop me by the doorstep.
I thought the unceasing sweat pouring out of me as I walked toward the station was simply the result of the terrible heat outside.
I thought it'd all go away once I reached the shade of the station… or once I got on the train with its many air conditioners.
But right now, I can't even board the train that I'll be getting off a single station later.
"…! Haah, hah… aaah…!"
I tried to stand up when the train came, but my entire body became overwhelmed with this gross, numbing sensation.
As my entire body was chained to the bench, it was only in my thoughts that I kept frantically yelling "move, move!"
Huh, what's going on? Did I misunderstand something?
My unceasing sweat, my heavy breath, my fear of crowds, my inability to board the train…
Could all of this be…
My body trying to reject the destination I'm heading to?
The unthinkable that flashed through my mind summoned a wave of nausea.
Because there's just no way that could possibly be. This is what I've wanted this entire week. Being with Haruki-kun is my happiness.
Seeing his sleeping face, engraving the few words he mutters in my heart, gazing at his ever so slightly changing expressions.
But is all of that… just my own ego talking?
Haruki-kun always looks so pained when I'm around him.
His sleeping face is always full of anguish, his words only hurt himself, and his expressions are only that of sadness.
And I'm sitting beside him every time, gazing at his despair.
I get it now… How could he possibly get better when he's visited by the angel of death every week?
Is that why God is trying to distance me from him? Because that's the best way to keep his heart at ease? Have I become nothing but a burden to him…?
Is that how He's protecting him?
"I don't want that…"
This is all wrong… Thinking about it that way is nothing but an ugly excuse.
It's a stupid justification for the fact that my body isn't as strong as my feelings.
"I don't want that…"
But it's so hot…
Besides, what will I do once I get there…?
Even if I stay by his side, he won't whisper words of love to me. He won't embrace me. That place isn't where I belong…
"Save me…"
What is unconditional love, I wonder…
Maybe you're the only one who knows after all…
"Save me, Kazusa…"
"I'm back!"
Beyond the front door is the same silence as always.
The only sound is that of my own rather loud voice.
"Ah, the air conditioner feels so good! I never want to go outside again."
However, the somewhat chilly air filling the room slowly reveals the dweller inside.
"It's so darn hot outside. I just can't stand it."
"Yeah…"
Today, that dweller is sitting in front of the computer on the dining table.
I take a glance at his face and see it's somewhat pale, but not completely white. It could be much worse.
Yeah, he might be feeling pretty well today.
"What do you want for lunch? It's a bit late, so is it okay if I make some Somen noodles? Or would you rather have something more filling?"
"I'm fine either way."
"I won't be as motivated if you're fine either way. Well, whatever. Let's go with a light lunch and a filling dinner then, okay?
"Oh, right! Since we already have pork, let's add it to the noodles cold… Yeah, that sounds great!"
"Setsuna."
"Ah, but then that means we'll have meat for both lunch and dinner. Perhaps I should make something different for dinner then."
"Listen, Setsuna…"
"What do you think, Haruki-kun? Do you want…"
"What happened today?"
Aah, I'm sorry, I couldn't make it yesterday. I had to work overtime the whole week so… No, what I meant to say was… work was just piling up a little."
"No, that's not what I'm asking about…"
"It'll be done right away. I'm sorry, but can you wait for a bit?"
I messed up… I wasn't supposed to show off how busy I am, because that'll just alienate him.
I can't allow myself to get carried away, no matter how excited I am.
"Phew, all done!"
"…Is that enough?"
"Yup, I'm stuffed."
"But you've barely eaten."
"I ate a bit too much for breakfast this morning. Sorry, but could you finish the rest, Haruki-kun?"
"I'm not sure if I can eat all of this…"
"You can leave some of it. The leftovers can go in the soup we'll have for dinner. Ahaha…"
"You really can't finish it?"
"No, I'll eat it. But I feel like I'll gain weight if I eat that much, since I barely move as it is."
"Now that you mention it! Wanna go for a walk after lunch as exercise? We don't have to go further than the nearby park."
"A walk, huh… Yeah, I don't mind."
"Ah, but… You'll probably get a heat stroke if you suddenly go outside in this weather. Sorry, I take back what I said."
What a simple mistake. What am I even talking about, going outside…?
"Really? That's amazing!"
"Yes, I'm managing to wake up properly in the mornings now, so maybe my sleep pattern is stabilizing."
"I see, I see… Then you're close to returning to work now!"
The words Haruki-kun spoke to me were amazing news.
The results of last week's medical diagnosis were unexpectedly good, and the physician even reduced his amount of medication.
"Well, there've been many ups and downs until now, so I don't know if I can return to work that easily."
"No, I know you'll manage this time! Everything will return to how it used to be…!"
"Setsuna…"
"Yes, yes! Ha, hahahaha."
I'm so glad… I'm so glad he's getting better so soon.
Haruki-kun will get better soon. Everyone will be freed from the burdens and the anguish.
Yes, everything will go well…
"Hey, Setsuna? Want to come over here and talk?"
"Hm, I'm okay. I'm not done vacuuming yet."
"You've been working nonstop since you came here. Take a break for once."
"I got to hear the most amazing news today, so I simply can't relax without working."
Because I've finally understood.
Working so hard that I barely have time to think about anything else is better for me right now.
"Hey, what should we do for summer break?"
After that, I kept working.
"A trip would of course still be too early for you, but you can still go outside a little in your current state, right?"
Once the laundry and the cleaning was done, I started cleaning the bathroom. Then I prepared dinner while Haruki-kun was taking a bath.
"We could go to the library you always visit. Then we could go for a tiny bit of shopping… go watch a movie…"
And then, it was finally nighttime.
"But we'll still have to avoid big crowds, though. Actually, what kind of shopping district doesn't have big crowds? Hahahaha."
…Somehow, we've made it through the day without incident.
"Even so I still look forward to it. We haven't gotten to spend a whole week together since university, on the summer break of our fourth year."
Today was fun, and so joyous.
"Setsuna."
"Although, even in university you'd keep finding reasons to not be with me, be it your graduation thesis, or your part-time job!"
He showed signs of improvement. He talked to me far more than usual. He ate all of the food I made for him.
"You were so stubborn. At times I'd even begin to wonder if you were still trying to avoid me or something… haha."
And as a natural result, I also found myself talking more, getting more excited.
"Listen, Setsuna."
"Besides, the summer before that was… Oh right, we weren't supposed to talk about that anymore! Sorry."
It's only natural for things to end up this way. Today has after all been full of happiness…
"Setsuna!"
There was real force in that voice, perhaps even the same kind of force I hadn't heard from him in half a year.
"Setsuna… I know it's too late, but I want to thank you again. Thank you so much for all the time you've spent taking care of me."
Even the words that followed after that had that same strength, kindness and softness to them.
"O-Oh jeez, what's the matter? There's no need to be so formal, I only did what's natural… being your girlfriend and all."
Is he really getting better?
That hope makes my heart pound even harder.
"It wasn't natural… It wasn't natural at all. Because I betrayed you, Setsuna. I betrayed and ran away from you, and then I broke down at the very end…"
"Did you now…? I seem to have completely forgotten."
"Despite that you devoted yourself to me, Setsuna."
"That was the only choice I had, because I…"
"I love you."
Can I finally say it now? Will he accept it if I do?
"If you weren't there for me, Setsuna… I would've ran away from everything, and in the end there'd be nowhere left to run away to.
"That's not…"
"I'm going to be indebted to you for the rest of my life. I'm really sorry."
My efforts have finally been rewarded…
I did it, I did it, I did it!
"It's okay… That will all resolve itself in time. Our future together still has such a long road ahead of it, after all."
My heartbeat is soaring. My body feels warm. My breath is heavy…
With this, I no longer… I no longer have to…
"So please, Setsuna… calm down and listen to my request."
"O-Okay!"
"Go home now. You don't have to come tomorrow, or during the summer break either."
But that's…
"I'm sorry…"
A bolt out of the blue, befitting the current season.
"I'm sorry that these cruel words are all that I can offer you."
"Haruki-kun…?"
"I'm sorry… I'm so sorry, Setsuna… Forgive me for being so weak…!"
What's going on? What is this?
Why? But why? Why, why, why?
…Why!?
"Forgive me, forgive me…! Uua… uu… aah…!"
What is this? Haruki-kun hasn't gotten better even in the slightest…
"The truth is, I wanted to send you home the moment you arrived here."
Wasn't he supposed to have fully recovered? Weren't my efforts supposed to have been finally rewarded?
"But I kept quiet about it until now. I'm sorry for being such a spineless coward."
But why? Why, why, why!?
Now that he's gotten better, he's just going to cast me aside?
"H-Haruki-kun…? Haruki-kun…!? Aa, aa… aaah!"
No, it's all wrong… I know better than anyone that he isn't that kind of person.
Could it be that… he's abandoning me because I'm terrible enough to make those kinds of assumptions of him?
"Why? Why would you…? What is it about me you don't like!?"
Is that why it won't work out? Will my feelings never reach him?
"What's wrong with me? I'll fix it… I'll change for you… So please don't say things like that…!"
My heartbeat is soaring. My body feels warm. My breath is heavy…
My body has gone numb and it refuses to move. My throat feels so terribly dry, yet the desire to vomit overwhelms me.
"I understood at a single glance…"
And right after… Haruki-kun softly touches my forehead.
No…
"That you were beginning to break down too, Setsuna…"
It's not just my forehead he's touching, but the pouring sweat as well…
"What… are…"
Haruki-kun turns off the faucet I left running, then bends down to pick up the broken pieces of the plate I dropped on the floor.
"It's getting harder for you to wake up in the mornings, isn't it?
"That's because… you know, I got low blood pressure."
But I remain unable to help him do any of that, only standing there, staring at where his eyes used to be before he bent down.
"Sometimes you notice that you can't stop sweating, and it suddenly hurts to breathe, doesn't it?"
"Only because it's summer. It's really hot outside…"
"Your feet stop moving. You find yourself unable to move forward."
I thought I drove it away, but the desire to vomit is now stronger than ever.
"And in order to hide that fact, you force yourself to keep your spirits up. You force yourself to act cheerful."
"What… are you…"
"And as you are playing the role of your usual self, you fail to realize that you're nothing like your usual self."
"Nothing… like?"
"Setsuna, you always took on the opposite demeanor as me. You'd act strong and cheerful when I was feeling down, and you'd tread carefully when I was cheerful."
I've overlooked everything.
"Thinking back now, I've come to realize that your demeanor was something you forced upon yourself in desperation, to put my heart at ease."
My shallow plan born out of desperation could never have worked on someone as clever as him.
"But today…"
Today, I got caught up in the idea that he was getting better, so I took my own spirits to an exaggerated height.
There's no way he wouldn't notice…
"I realized that maybe, you were throwing all your energy into deceiving yourself today, Setsuna. That you felt so cornered that you had no other choice…"
"No, that's not true… You're just misunderstanding things…"
"I'm confident that I know your current self better than you do yourself, Setsuna."
"Why!? Haruki-kun, what could you possibly know about me…!?"
"How couldn't I know…? How could I possibly not notice the state you're in right now, Setsuna…?"
At that moment, I understood what Haruki-kun was trying to tell me better than he did himself.
"Because right now, Setsuna… you're just like I was half a year ago."
And everything I knew he would say, he engraved in my mind word for word.
"Worse still, I got nothing less than I deserved, but you've done nothing wrong, Setsuna. You only got dragged into this because of me."
Along with words that are hurting himselfーwords that I never wanted to hear.
"Uaa, aa, aah… Aa… Aaaaah!"
Haruki-kun is crying again…
He was finally feeling better. He was finally nearing his recovery, yet…
I ended up making a mess of it all. This is all my fault.
"So just go home, Setsuna… and take proper care of yourself."
Does… Does it mean then, that…
"N-No… No!"
Regardless if I'm by his side or far apart… I'll remain nothing but a burden to him?
"You can still make it in time. If you go right now, you can avoid turning out like me."
"B-But, but… What'll happen to you then, Haruki-kun…?"
"I'll be… fine. I told you I'm getting better, didn't I?"
"But you're crying right now! You're breaking apart because of me again!"
"It's only for a little bit… I'll recover after a good rest."
"That won't do… Even the doctor said so! He said the recovery period is the most dangerous of all."
"The doctor also said this… 'The time one's starting to get sick is the most important time to pay attention.'"
"Hey, Setsuna… I'm begging you, listen to me."
His tearful voice stirs up my own tears, and an overwhelming desire to cling to him, crying and screaming, overtakes me.
"If you go about this the wrong way now, you'll never be able to undo it."
"H-Ha…Haruki-kun…"
But I can't cry nor scream. Neither can I cling to him.
I'd break him if I did. Just as I thought, I'd be nothing but a burden to him, an angel of death.
"I'll say it as many times as it takes, Setsuna."
And…
Mustering up whatever courage remains in his broken self, Haruki-kun… cuts me away from him.
"Go home for today."
He's choosing to enter hell by himself, so that he won't have to bring me down with him.
"And don't come back here for a while."
Without hesitation, he's choosing to protect me without any regard for the fact that he's fallen apart.
"No… Never come back."
Even though he was prepared to bring Kazusa down to hell with him.
